title: Japanese Donabe Chicken and Rice
description: A Japanese-inspired dish made with chicken, rice, and a donabe. This hearty meal is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Rinse the donabe rice thoroughly and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pot, heat the dashi broth over medium heat.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, and green onions to the pot and stir to combine.
Transfer the cooked rice to a serving dish and top with the chicken and sauce.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve hot.
